topic: Suez Canal ships crossing the desert
hook: Your ship in Egypt seems to sail across sand.
title: Your ship seems to sail through sand
description:
From the shore of the Suez Canal, giant ships look like they glide straight across the Egyptian desert. The canal links the Mediterranean and the Red Sea. Series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.
